name: Tristin
source: Tristin is desperate to escape, just like Ellie. He is broody, and quiet. He is a kind soul, but is clearly either lying or deep in denial about just what he has become during his time trapped in Myyr. His "sad puppy" nickname could be a hint to what he really is.
